This '''thug''' was a member of the [[Patrolian/Legends|Patrolian]] species. He was present in [[Moshi Bar/Legends|Moshi Bar]] when [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] and [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]] entered. He was seen talking to an [[Unidentified Ithorian (Moshi Bar)/Legends|Ithorian]] about something he saw on a video screen the previous night while the two [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] were there.
